question: The Balti dance of ____________ is distinct as it has its own costume, music and songs in the Balti language. The dance is only performed on rare occasions, such as feasts or celebrations.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Balti dance is a traditional dance form of **Ladakh**.
 
• This dance is distinct due to its unique costume, music, and songs in the Balti language.
 
• The Balti dance is performed only on rare occasions such as feasts or celebration
